 File Name         : BH_SMU_Communication
 Description       :  This is the template for SMU Comms Overview screen. By default this screen is configured for 8 SMUs. Unused SMUs shall be removed if necessary. SMU is an object, any additional one can be added by copy-pasting existing object and adding 2 extra external parameters (SMUxName, SMUxTagPath) to the template.
